assert.stdout_contains: only system:tracker-sync may set a task key

not_observable.case: tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_sync_actor_creates_task_with_tracker_key: the system:tracker-sync actor is not reachable from the CLI or HTTP (the API always acts as a human), so a task keyed ABC-7 by the sync, and the counter continuing after it, cannot be created by the runner; a fake Jira sync would create it

tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_human_and_agent_cannot_set_a_tracker_key (agent half): neither the CLI nor the MCP task_create tool accepts a key argument, and the HTTP route always acts as a human, so an agent actor cannot submit a tracker key

tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_tracker_key_must_match_the_format (params abc-1, ABC1, ABC-, ABC-x, 1ABC-1, ABCDEFGHIJK-1): the format check runs only after the sync-actor check, so a non-sync caller always gets permission_denied and the validation_failed path needs the sync actor
tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_tracker_key_prefix_cannot_be_the_workspace_prefix: the WG prefix refusal is reached only with the sync actor, which the runner cannot act as
tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_duplicate_tracker_key_conflicts: a second task with the same tracker key needs the sync actor to set the key the first time

tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_rejected_tracker_key_does_not_consume_a_number: the rejected key is WG-1 set by the sync actor, which the runner cannot act as; this scenario checks only that a refused HTTP key does not consume a number

tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_task_out_lists_links_ordered_by_kind_then_url: task_links rows are written only by tracker sync or a direct database insert, neither reachable from the runner, so the link ordering in task show cannot be seeded

tests/integration/test_tracker_keys.py::test_migration_0009_moves_external_refs_into_task_links: the migration test upgrades a database file to 0008, inserts rows, then upgrades and downgrades it, which the runner cannot do (no migration step, and db assertions are skipped)
